title: Blue competence, trust, and red excitement associations
statement:
The color blue is strongly associated with competence, trust, and functionality, while red is associated with excitement and hedonic value.

Options:
- Competence & Trust: #1565C0 (Navy Blue) (fits: banking, corporate b2b)
- Excitement: #D32F2F (Vibrant Red) (fits: entertainment, fast food)
- Sincerity: #757575 (Neutral Grey) (fits: non profits, education)
appliesWhen: Applies to: b2b saas, fintech, ecommerce. Audience: general, b2b buyers.

source.title: Exciting red and competent blue: the importance of color in marketing
source.authors: Lauren I. Labrecque; George R. Milne
source.venue: Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science
